//: Production, non-secret configuration for the Main API (ADR-0036). Secrets are supplied by the container environment, never committed: ConnectionStrings__maindb, Auth__Jwt__SigningKey, Mail__Username, Mail__Password. See deploy/.env.example.

Cors.//: The federated suite origins (ADR-0046). This is also the SSO return-uri allow-list (ADR-0039) — keep it in step with the SuiteApps origins in each WebApp's appsettings.Production.json.

Passkey.//: RP ID is the registrable apex so one passkey spans every subdomain (ADR-0046, FR-010). Non-migratable — settle before the first real passkey.

Mail.//: Brevo SMTP relay (ADR-0037). Host/Port/From are non-secret; Username + Password come from the environment. ClientBaseUrl is the fallback origin; per-app branding + link origins are in Apps (ADR-0064).
Mail.//Apps: Per-source-app mail identity (ADR-0064). Keep BaseUrl origins in step with Cors.AllowedOrigins. LogoUrl is left unset until a white-on-transparent PNG email logo exists per app.
